narr: Scattered storms developed along a surface trough and in a hot and humid airmass on June 26. An isolated storm produced minor flash flooding in the City of Richmond in the afternoon hours.
ev: The public reported water over the roadway at Chamberlayne Avenue and Brookland Parkway via Waze. This report was corroborated by a VDOT camera on I-95 at mile marker 78.
The public reported flooding along Atlee Road at I-295.
lsr: Public Waze report of water over roadway at Chamberlayne and Brookland Rd corroborated by VDOT camera at I-95 MM78.
